entities.summary: Bogdan Gajda is a Polish boxer. He competed at the 1976 Summer Olympics and the 1980 Summer Olympics. At the 1976 Summer Olympics, he lost to Vassily Solomin of the Soviet Union. At the 1980 Summer Olympics, he lost to Shadrach Odhiambo of Sweden.
